description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
